blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Should Vice President Sara Duterte be removed from office, Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero said that he would refuse any nominations for him to assume the vice presidency, as he cited conflict of interest. During an episode of his podcast aired on Sunday, one of the podcast hosts asked Escudero if he would accept any offer for him to become vice president if Duterte is convicted following her impeachment trial. Escudero said that no one has made any offer to him yet. “Hindi ko tatanggapin sa simpleng rason, conflict of interest. Kami ’yung nagpasya eh. Hindi yata tama ’yun,” […]...
